title: IBM Heron 超導量子處理器

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在IBM Heron 超導量子處理器案例中比較transmon 能階與Heron 耦合圖，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate transmon levels and heron coupling graph within the IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor case.

steps.title: 超導電路與非諧性：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Superconducting circuits and anharmonicity: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對transmon 能階提出可反駁的超導電路與非諧性模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable superconducting circuits and anharmonicity model and evidence record for transmon levels.
steps.instruction: 在「IBM Heron 超導量子處理器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識transmon 能階。約瑟夫森接面提供非線性電感；非諧性使兩個能階可從其他能階分開控制。 建立超導電路與非諧性的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較理想諧振器與非諧振子的能階及洩漏。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify transmon levels in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor. Josephson junctions supply nonlinear inductance; anharmonicity separates a controlled two-level subspace from other levels. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of superconducting circuits and anharmonicity, focusing on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare oscillator/anharmonic level spacings and leakage. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較理想諧振器與非諧振子的能階及洩漏。
steps.observationEn: Compare oscillator/anharmonic level spacings and leakage.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有諧振器都天然等同隔離良好的二能階位元。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every oscillator naturally forms an isolated two-level qubit.
steps.check: 提交transmon 能階的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for transmon levels.

knowledge.title: 超導電路與非諧性
knowledge.text: 約瑟夫森接面提供非線性電感；非諧性使兩個能階可從其他能階分開控制。 本課架構對應：transmon 能階
knowledge.textEn: Josephson junctions supply nonlinear inductance; anharmonicity separates a controlled two-level subspace from other levels. Course architecture correspondence: Transmon levels

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 比較理想諧振器與非諧振子的能階及洩漏。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；所有諧振器都天然等同隔離良好的二能階位元。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compare oscillator/anharmonic level spacings and leakage. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Every oscillator naturally forms an isolated two-level qubit.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設 30 個獨立且相同錯誤率 p=0.0010 的事件，無錯誤機率 (1−p)^30=0.970431。此簡化不含相干、相關、洩漏與讀出錯誤，不能預測完整量子電路或邏輯精度。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 30 independent events with equal p=0.0010: no-error probability (1−p)^30=0.970431. Coherent, correlated, leakage and readout errors are omitted; this does not predict full-circuit/logical fidelity.

quiz.question: 就transmon 能階的「超導電路與非諧性」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for superconducting circuits and anharmonicity in transmon levels?
options: 約瑟夫森接面提供非線性電感；非諧性使兩個能階可從其他能階分開控制。
所有諧振器都天然等同隔離良好的二能階位元。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Josephson junctions supply nonlinear inductance; anharmonicity separates a controlled two-level subspace from other levels.
Every oscillator naturally forms an isolated two-level qubit.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 約瑟夫森接面提供非線性電感；非諧性使兩個能階可從其他能階分開控制。 比較理想諧振器與非諧振子的能階及洩漏。
quiz.explanationEn: Josephson junctions supply nonlinear inductance; anharmonicity separates a controlled two-level subspace from other levels. Compare oscillator/anharmonic level spacings and leakage.

steps.title: 超導電路與非諧性：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Superconducting circuits and anharmonicity: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對transmon 能階提出可反駁的超導電路與非諧性模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable superconducting circuits and anharmonicity model and evidence record for transmon levels.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「超導電路與非諧性」模型，檢查transmon 能階的兩個假想案例。比較理想諧振器與非諧振子的能階及洩漏。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分約瑟夫森接面提供非線性電感；非諧性使兩個能階可從其他能階分開控制。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous superconducting circuits and anharmonicity model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving transmon levels. Compare oscillator/anharmonic level spacings and leakage. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Josephson junctions supply nonlinear inductance; anharmonicity separates a controlled two-level subspace from other levels." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 比較理想諧振器與非諧振子的能階及洩漏。
steps.observationEn: Compare oscillator/anharmonic level spacings and leakage.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有諧振器都天然等同隔離良好的二能階位元。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every oscillator naturally forms an isolated two-level qubit.
steps.check: 提交transmon 能階的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for transmon levels.

steps.title: 耦合圖與路由：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Coupling graphs and routing: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對Heron 耦合圖提出可反駁的耦合圖與路由模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable coupling graphs and routing model and evidence record for heron coupling graph.
steps.instruction: 在「IBM Heron 超導量子處理器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Heron 耦合圖。原生可用的雙位元連線限制編譯；SWAP 路由增加深度與噪聲暴露。 建立耦合圖與路由的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對相同邏輯電路比較兩張耦合圖的路由深度。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify heron coupling graph in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor. Native two-qubit connectivity constrains compilation; SWAP routing increases depth and noise exposure. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of coupling graphs and routing, focusing on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Route the same circuit on two graphs and compare depth. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 對相同邏輯電路比較兩張耦合圖的路由深度。
steps.observationEn: Route the same circuit on two graphs and compare depth.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：物理位元數相同就代表相同電路成本。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Equal physical-qubit counts imply equal circuit costs.
steps.check: 提交Heron 耦合圖的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for heron coupling graph.

steps.title: 微波控制與串擾：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Microwave control and crosstalk: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對微波控制線提出可反駁的微波控制與串擾模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable microwave control and crosstalk model and evidence record for microwave control lines.
steps.instruction: 在「IBM Heron 超導量子處理器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識微波控制線。控制脈衝的頻譜可同時激發鄰近模態；閘錯誤不只是振幅偏差。 建立微波控制與串擾的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較單獨與同時操作的假想錯誤矩陣。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify microwave control lines in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor. Control spectra can excite neighboring modes; gate error is not only amplitude error. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of microwave control and crosstalk, focusing on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare hypothetical isolated and simultaneous-operation error matrices. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較單獨與同時操作的假想錯誤矩陣。
steps.observationEn: Compare hypothetical isolated and simultaneous-operation error matrices.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：單獨量到的閘精度可直接代表同時操作精度。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Isolated gate fidelity directly equals simultaneous-operation fidelity.
steps.check: 提交微波控制線的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

steps.instruction: 在「IBM Heron 超導量子處理器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識多溫層熱路。每條控制線帶入熱與雜訊；低溫層的冷卻能力需按溫度分開預算。 建立低溫熱路與訊號負載的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。建立各溫層的負載、裕度與線數假想表。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify multistage heat paths in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor. Each control line carries heat and noise; cooling capacity is budgeted separately by temperature stage. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of cryogenic heat paths and signal loads, focusing on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Build an assumed load, margin and line-count table per stage. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.titleEn: Error correction and logical evidence: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對邏輯錯誤證據提出可反駁的錯誤更正與邏輯證據模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable error correction and logical evidence model and evidence record for logical-error evidence.
steps.instruction: 在「IBM Heron 超導量子處理器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識邏輯錯誤證據。邏輯錯誤率與物理錯誤率不同；閾值行為需跨碼距且控制實驗條件。 建立錯誤更正與邏輯證據的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較碼距增加時的每循環邏輯錯誤與置信區間。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify logical-error evidence in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor. Logical and physical error rates differ; threshold behavior requires comparisons across code distances under controlled conditions. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of error correction and logical evidence, focusing on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare logical error per cycle and confidence intervals across code distances. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設 30 個獨立且相同錯誤率 p=0.0010 的事件，無錯誤機率 (1−p)^30=0.970431。此簡化不含相干、相關、洩漏與讀出錯誤，不能預測完整量子電路或邏輯精度。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 30 independent events with equal p=0.0010: no-error probability (1−p)^30=0.970431. Coherent, correlated, leakage and readout errors are omitted; this does not predict full-circuit/logical fidelity.

Logical and physical error rates differ; threshold behavior requires comparisons across code distances under controlled conditions.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.

steps.title: 錯誤更正與邏輯證據：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Error correction and logical evidence: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對邏輯錯誤證據提出可反駁的錯誤更正與邏輯證據模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable error correction and logical evidence model and evidence record for logical-error evidence.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「錯誤更正與邏輯證據」模型，檢查邏輯錯誤證據的兩個假想案例。比較碼距增加時的每循環邏輯錯誤與置信區間。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分邏輯錯誤率與物理錯誤率不同；閾值行為需跨碼距且控制實驗條件。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous error correction and logical evidence model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving logical-error evidence. Compare logical error per cycle and confidence intervals across code distances. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Logical and physical error rates differ; threshold behavior requires comparisons across code distances under controlled conditions." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 比較碼距增加時的每循環邏輯錯誤與置信區間。
steps.observationEn: Compare logical error per cycle and confidence intervals across code distances.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：增加物理位元必然降低邏輯錯誤。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: More physical qubits necessarily reduce logical error.
steps.check: 提交邏輯錯誤證據的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for logical-error evidence.

knowledge.textEn: Assume 30 independent events with equal p=0.0010: no-error probability (1−p)^30=0.970431. Coherent, correlated, leakage and readout errors are omitted; this does not predict full-circuit/logical fidelity.
